summary: Verified tudo_mais_facil.rbz v1.2.0 first-draft bundle (Lastro + Módulo plugins). All 18 tests pass (11 new v1.2 tests + 7 iter8 regression). RBZ shape/version/entries correct, Ruby 2.2.4 compat clean, all Ruby files pass `ruby -c`, both HTML dialogs render with the full field set, dark+gold visual style + triangular ± + CM/MM toggles all confirmed on browser preview. Home.jsx copy updated. No backend regressions. No blocking bugs — this is a solid first-draft compilado ready for user's SketchUp visual QA tomorrow.

verifications_performed.ruby22_compat: No .dig(, no &., no transform_values/keys, no .sum found across any .rb file
verifications_performed.lastro_html: Title 'Lastro de Cozinha' + 3 numeric ids (f-comprimento, f-altura, f-espessura) + f-madeira select with options ['pinus_tratado','grapia'] + f-valor + 'Gerar lastro no SketchUp' button + CM/MM toggles + triangle buttons — all present
verifications_performed.modulo_html: All 21 required field ids present + 'Gerar módulo 3D no SketchUp' button + 15 triangle ± buttons + 9 CM/MM toggles
verifications_performed.modulo_selects_empty_in_preview: EXPECTED behavior — f-tipo_puxador, f-tipo_dobradica, f-pos_usinagem_dobradica, f-tipo_gaveta, f-tipo_trilho have 0 static <option>s because modulo.rb pushes presets at runtime via dialog.execute_script('window.tmfModuloReady(...)'). Only f-cor_chapa has static options (5). This works correctly inside SketchUp HtmlDialog; browser preview will show empty selects (as noted in the task's other_misc_info).
verifications_performed.main_rb_menus: Both menu items wired: '🪵 Lastro de Cozinha…' → TudoMaisFacil::Lastro.show_wizard and '📦 Construtor de Módulos…' → TudoMaisFacil::Modulo.show_wizard, plus 2 toolbar commands
verifications_performed.preview_urls: /preview_plugin/lastro.html, /preview_plugin/modulo.html, /preview_plugin/tmf.css all serve HTTP 200 with expected markers
verifications_performed.home_jsx_copy: 'v1.2 · PAREDES + LASTRO + MÓDULOS' + mentions of 'Lastro de Cozinha' & 'Construtor de Módulos' + 'INSTALAR EM 4 PASSOS (SKETCHUP 2018 – 2026)' all present
verifications_performed.backend_regression: iter7/8 suite (test_paredes_angulo_and_downloads.py) still 7/7 passing after only fixing a stale version-assertion string (1.1.1 → 1.2.0)

critical_code_review_comments: modulo.rb is 9.7 KB and modulo.html is 17.3 KB — well under the 700-line/file threshold, healthy structure.
Good separation: Lastro and Modulo each have their own .rb + .html; shared tmf.css keeps visuals consistent.
Presets (PUXADORES, DOBRADICAS, POS_USINAGEM, TIPO_GAVETA, TIPO_TRILHO) are defined in modulo.rb and injected at runtime — clean pattern, avoids duplication.

Nit for iter10: on modulo.html the select-dropdown labels 'TIPO DE PUXADOR', 'TIPO DE DOBRADIÇA', 'POSIÇÃO USINAGEM DOBRADIÇA' render empty in the browser preview; consider a placeholder <option value=''>— (preencha no SketchUp) —</option> so the preview doesn't look broken during design review outside SketchUp. Not a functional bug.
loader.rb and dialog.rb from v1.0/1.1 remain unchanged — no dead code detected.
